INTRODUCTION The computer, as a revolution, has left no area of life intact in today’s world. It is of great help in all areas of life. Therefore, computer literacy is a necessity for everyone’s existence in this global village. The computer is becoming increasingly mandatory in almost all fields of study, not because of its precision and versatility in the data processing. Many activities at home or in the office are quickly automated by the computer. Therefore, it is obvious that, in any discipline or sector of work, the computer is now a very important tool for improving the efficiency and accuracy of the execution. It has been designed to meet the preliminary needs of all those interested and who want to know computer science and IT in general. A computer is an electronic device that works under the control of instructions stored in its memory. These instructions tell to machine what to do. The computer is able to accept data (inputs), process them arithmetically and logically, produce processing outputs, and store the results for future use. Most of the computers on a desktop are called personal computers (PCs). The “computer” is a collection of different machines that you will use to do your job. A computer consists mainly of the central processing unit (usually called a computer), a monitor, a keyboard, and a mouse. Advantages: It connects to Internet, allowing you to send emails, browse content, get information, use social media platforms, and more. When you connect to the Internet, you can also connect long-distance with your friends and family. Archiving: A computer allows you to archive a large amount of information; for example, you can archive projects, e-books, documents, films, photos, music, and more. Organized data and information: Allows not only to store data but also to organize it. Improve your skills: It helps you write good English if you are not good at spelling and grammar. Likewise, if you’re not good at math and don’t have a good memory, you can use computer to perform calculations and store results. It can be used to help people with disabilities, for example, Stephen Hawking, who was unable to speak on the computer he was talking to. It can also be used to help blind people by installing special software to read what’s on the screen. You can use your computer to listen to music, watch movies, play games and more.
